Review with the teams before hand and handle changes done before presenting to COO. 8) Define SOPs and Standardize cross function processes: Define SOPs and processes for different functions. Identify opportunities to optimize processes and manage cross-functional programs to execute on the same. Desired Skills and capabilities
1. Business acumen: You should have a strong understanding of business and revenue models, ability to translate business goals to functional goals for the organization
2. Leadership Skills: You possess strong leadership skills to effectively manage relationships with senior executives (COO direct reportees, other senior leaders in the organization) and senior peers. Ability to get work done without having reporting relationships with the teams
3. Strategic Planning: You should be able to track progress against the annual operating plan (AOP), strategic initiatives etc.
4. Communication Skills: You possess excellent communication skills to effectively communicate with senior team members, and other stakeholders.
5. Analytical Skills: You possess strong analytical skills to be able to work with large data sets, create actionable and insightful reports. Should be. Highly detail oriented and organized way of working: You should be organized and meticulous in day to day work, to be able to handle a variety of projects at a given point of time.
7. Education Qualification and Experience: You should be an Engineer and MBA from a Tier I college with 6-8 years of experience either in management consulting with a focus on strategy and operations engagements; or program management; or playing chief of staff role
